messages:
marta: quick heads — during sapphire-7b bring-up we discovered ~18% overlap between the new sample shard and the current golden holdout. need a fast plan to resample and avoid poisoning evals
cheng: ugh, thanks for flagging. is that overlap at the prompt id level or fuzzy-duplicate level?
marta: prompt_id level + a small tail of paraphrase near-duplicates. i ran a quick dedupe query, results look real.
liam: can you paste the query? i'll run it against the labeler queue to mark collisions
marta: here — SQL to find exact id overlap:
```
select p.prompt_id, count(*) from incoming_samples p join golden_holdout g on p.prompt_id = g.prompt_id group by p.prompt_id;
```
cheng: nice. for paraphrase/nearly-duplicate we should run the fingerprint r12 hash + token-overlap check. i can kick that off.
nana: @labeling-squad heads up — if we resample, there will be ~2.2k items that need relabeling priority. what's capacity this week? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
labeling-squad: capacity is tight — we can take 600 this week and ramp to 2k next week if we split into quick/long queues. prefer marking high-bleed prompts first.
liam: proposal: immediate action — remove exact prompt_id matches from sapphire shard, replace with backfill from low-similarity pool; flag borderline paraphrases into "investigate" bucket (priority 1) for labeling next week.
cheng: agree. i'll produce a backfill list with a similarity threshold < 0.15. also will attach a small sample of borderline pairs for human inspection.
marta: ops note — for backlog routing set this in sampler config:
```yaml
holdout_mode: strict
exclude_prompt_ids: [FILE:/tmp/sapphire_overlap_ids.txt]
backfill_policy: low_similarity_pool
```
liam: labeler UX: when you flag borderline pairs, include the model output diff snapshot so labelers can see why it's borderline. small snippet plus model logits if available.
nana: can we avoid rerunning full quant smoke for sapphire until backfill finishes? otherwise eval numbers will be noisy.
cheng: yeah hold quant runs for the canary. we can run lightweight perf/latency sanity but block quality metrics until new holdout is in place.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: sampler exclude list ingestion job queued (job id j-92a7). ETA ~7m.
marta: thanks — action items: (1) cheng generate backfill and borderline sample, (2) liam push exclude ids to sampler, (3) labeling-squad take 600 quick-priority, (4) hold full quant smoke until new holdout in place. i'll follow up with a small audit report once re-run complete. :white_check_mark:
labeling-squad: acknowledged. will create a short labeling guide for borderline cases (examples + rubric) and ping here when ready.
liam: i'll also add a small check in the eval harness to assert no prompt_id collisions — quick guardrail.
cheng: sample for inspection attached to the ticket TKT-4821. ping me if you want a live walk-through.
marta: perfect. thanks everyone. keeping this thread for the audit traces.
